description: Validates domain concepts have been properly extracted and categorized

checks.description: Both domain concepts files must exist
Domain concepts must include entities, business concepts, terminology, and relationships
checks.remediation: Write all four sections; verify the requirements contain sufficient domain information

checks.description: Every entity must have an ID and a name
checks.remediation: Give every entity an ENT-[###] id and a name

checks.description: A plausible number of entities should be identified
checks.remediation: Very few entities may indicate insufficient analysis; very many may mean attributes or terms were recorded as entities

checks.description: Entities should be assigned to a domain area
checks.remediation: Assign a domain_area to each entity

checks.description: Entities should cite the requirements they came from
checks.remediation: Add source_refs with requirement IDs to each entity
